comparison_design: v0.3 and v0.4 both use chronological outer folds; v0.3 target-model choices use only earlier outer folds; v0.4 position gate is chosen only from 2021-2024 development folds; 2025 remains untouched
interpretation: The selection-safe v0.3 comparator confirms that the apparent v0.4 edge is not merely an artifact of comparing against fixed 60/30/10.
WR is the strongest independent proof: final-holdout MAE/RMSE/rank all improve and paired bootstrap excludes zero.
RB has operationally meaningful gains but one historical loss and a final-position bootstrap interval crossing zero.
TE is consistently positive versus nested v0.3 across rolling folds, but the absolute final-holdout gain is modest.
QB improvement comes from refusing unstable v0.4 complexity and retaining the transparent baseline rather than from a new richer QB model.
